description: Fix exact path containment, add traversal/sibling-prefix property tests, and enforce Disk list/materialization permissions so nil person_id is public-only unless skip_permissions is explicit.

comments.text: Path containment fixed and covered by FileExplorer regression/property tests. Pausing before Disk ACL implementation: Storage receives actor context only for materialization after additional wiring, and raw Storage files currently lack a clear public/private marker. Need decision on whether Disk raw file listing/materialization should default to public, require imported Document permissions, or use Storage ResourcePermission rows.

Reopened after review: Storage ACL must match ZAQ permission semantics. No resource_permission rows means private/admin-only, not public. StorageEntry access must require skip_permissions:true or matching read grant.

Corrected Storage ACL semantics: ungranted StorageEntry rows are private by default; access now requires matching read permission or explicit skip_permissions:true. BO admin actor handling extracted to ZaqWeb.Live.BO.AI.BOActor. Validated by focused Storage/Skills tests and final mix q.
